publication: Jean-Yves Girard, Proofs and Types, translated and with appendices by Paul Taylor and Yves Lafont, Cambridge University Press1989, corrected1990 edition reprinted for web2003; 183 PDF pages.

reviews.checked_passages: Ch.2 pp.8–13: ND rules and proof substitution. Ch.5 §§5.1–5.4 pp.29–40: classical/intuitionistic sequent rules, cut-free last-rule and instance-subformula properties, ND/sequent translations. Text read directly; scope distinctions for the noble fragment checked.
reviews.consumers: Corpus adoption at the linked minimal-logic, normal-verification, classical connective-bridge and pure extraction blocks. Full native positive-connective and primitive-negation constructions are supplied locally; the inspected source translation has its stated restricted fragment.
reviews.outcome: No defect found in selected scope. Ch.5.3 restricts its explicit ND translation to the fragment without disjunction, existential or negation; full native verifications and primitive-negation bridges are original corpus constructions, not attributed as supplied by that section. Minimal-logic comparison removes explosion from the known rule list and supplies its own proofs/countermodels. Strong normalization and type-theory chapters are not adopted.
